purpose: Track external open-source components that may inform or accelerate trend-exploring without copying third-party source code into this repository.

policies.neutralRadarInvariant: Personal interests, clicks, memory, and profile data must not affect global collection, candidate generation, ranking, or reports.

projects.description: Global intelligence dashboard with curated feeds, multilingual coverage, cross-stream correlation, maps, APIs, and MCP surfaces.

license.note: Do not copy code into the private product without a deliberate AGPL-compatible licensing decision.

components.name: Curated source catalog and freshness monitor
triggers: Design the first multilingual source inventory
Implement source health and freshness reporting
mustPreserve: Rights and observability must be explicit
Popularity must not substitute for coverage allocation

components.name: Cross-stream event convergence
triggers: Implement signals spanning news, economic, disaster, and action streams
mustPreserve: Correlation is not causation
Every derived link must retain source and model lineage

projects.description: Chinese-oriented multi-platform hot-list and RSS monitor with AI analysis, scheduled reports, MCP, and notification channels.

license.note: Use architecture and UX observations only until the product license is decided.

components.name: Scheduled reports and multi-channel delivery
triggers: Build the 08:00 and 19:00 shadow editions
Add delivery channel adapters
mustPreserve: Committed report representation must equal delivered bytes
Delivery failures must not create a successful edition

components.name: Read-only MCP query surface
triggers: Expose historical reports and signal queries to AI clients
mustPreserve: Tools must enforce snapshot membership and revocation epochs
Personal query context must not feed global ranking

projects.description: Typed TypeScript adapters for many Chinese and international real-time news and hot-list sources.

license.note: Each upstream source still requires independent rights, robots, terms, and retention review.

components.name: Typed source-adapter contract
triggers: Implement the first real source connector
Define a connector conformance fixture
mustPreserve: A connector license does not grant rights to upstream content
Hot-list rank must be stored as source assertion, not world importance
Failures and missing pages must remain in the denominator

projects.description: The ingestion pipeline used by Media Cloud's online news archive, including RSS queueing, fetching, metadata extraction, and indexing workers.

license.note: Low star count is not a negative signal here; it is an actively maintained infrastructure component in the Media Cloud organization.

components.name: Queued news ingestion stages
triggers: Implement fetch to capture to metadata extraction
Define retry and terminal failure boundaries
mustPreserve: Raw bytes must be stored before derived parsing
Retries must not create duplicate logical captures
Watermarks cannot cross open gaps

projects.description: Mature self-hosted RSS/Atom aggregator with WebSub, scraping, authentication, extensions, and multiple database backends.

license.note: Consider as a separately deployed service only after architecture and AGPL obligations are reviewed.

components.name: Feed polling, WebSub, and scraping operations
triggers: Harden feed discovery and conditional fetch behavior
Add WebSub-capable sources
mustPreserve: Subscription choices must not define the global coverage universe
Scraping must pass source-specific rights review

projects.description: Threat-intelligence knowledge platform with connectors, primary-source linkage, entities, relationships, first/last seen time, confidence, GraphQL, and import/export.

license.expression: Apache-2.0 for Community Edition; proprietary terms for Enterprise Edition
license.note: Confirm that any evaluated file belongs to Community Edition before reuse.

components.name: Primary-source, relationship, and confidence model
triggers: Implement canonical entity and evidence relationships
Design source-linked confidence views
borrow: Every information item linked to a primary source
mustPreserve: Confidence cannot replace evidence entailment
Source claims and AI inferences require different gates
Threat-domain STIX entities must not leak into the general ontology

components.name: Connector runtime and integration tests
triggers: Run more than one independently deployed connector
mustPreserve: Connector identity, configuration, and execution records remain immutable and separate

projects.description: Structured intelligence sharing platform with events, attribute-level distribution, correlation, taxonomies, sightings, collaboration, APIs, and audit controls.

license.note: Reference governance concepts only unless an AGPL-compatible product decision is made.

components.name: Sightings, taxonomy, and correlation workflow
triggers: Implement repeated observations and counter-evidence
Define controlled signal taxonomies
mustPreserve: A repeated source is not an independent sighting
Correlation must retain its method and evidence

components.name: Attribute-level distribution controls
triggers: Implement multi-audience exports or shared collections
mustPreserve: Every delivery rechecks the current rights and revocation epoch

projects.description: Time-series toolkit with change-point detection, anomaly detection, forecasting, feature extraction, evaluators, and simulators.

license.note: Evaluate maintained modules and transitive dependencies before selecting it as a runtime dependency.

components.name: Change-point and anomaly baseline
triggers: Establish non-LLM baselines for temporal change detection
mustPreserve: Detection opportunity denominators must be frozen before scoring
Statistical alerts do not become claims without evidence gates

projects.description: Large-scale event analytics product for velocity, ranking, collections, geographic distribution, and natural-language-to-SQL exploration.

license.note: Prefer metric definitions and query patterns over importing the whole GitHub-specific stack.

components.name: Velocity and cohort trend metrics
triggers: Implement growth velocity and cross-cohort trend views
mustPreserve: Rankings require explicit denominators and observation windows
Popularity and weak-signal exposure remain separate channels

projects.description: Small financial-news pipeline using multi-source ingestion, NLP, impact scoring, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, LangGraph, and a dashboard.

license.note: Treat as a prototype reference; do not infer production maturity from its complete-looking architecture.

components.name: News-to-graph vertical-slice prototype
triggers: Prototype the first news to entity graph to report flow
mustPreserve: Graph writes must retain raw-record lineage
Impact scores are provisional features, not factual claims

projects.description: Personal multi-source news aggregator with RSS, Reddit, social/video sources, multiple LLM backends, summaries, and experimental research agents.

license.note: Its personal-interest workflow must remain outside the global radar path.

components.name: Multi-provider LLM adapter boundary
triggers: Support more than one model provider in shadow mode
mustPreserve: All model calls pass outbound payload and provider response closure
Personal notes and interests remain in the personal domain

projects.description: Investigative document and structured-data search platform with entity extraction and graph-oriented exploration.

license.note: The open-source version announced maintenance sunset after December 2025; do not adopt it as a new platform dependency.

components.name: Document ingestion and entity exploration UX
triggers: Add large document collections and investigative entity search
mustPreserve: Do not build new runtime dependencies on a sunsetted codebase
